business_goals.statement: Cut average handling time per letter by at least 40%

business_goals.target: cleared within three months of go-live

business_goals.statement: Make letters easier for customers to understand

personas.name: Claims adjuster
personas.needs: A good first draft in front of them, with claim details pre-filled

personas.name: Team lead
personas.needs: Visibility of draft quality across the team

pain_points: About 22 minutes of handling time per letter
Templates are out of date, so adjusters copy from old letters

functional.statement: Generate draft letters from the claim file in the adjuster workspace using house style and templates
functional.source_quote: Generate draft letters from the claim file in the adjuster workspace, in our house style and with the correct template.

functional.statement: Automatically send simple letters (status updates, document acknowledgements) without adjuster review
functional.source_quote: For simple letters like status updates and document acknowledgements, I want it to send automatically.

functional.statement: Let adjusters edit and approve drafts of complex letters before they go out
functional.source_quote: Adjusters edit and approve the draft before it goes out.

functional.statement: Pre-fill claim number, dates and amounts from the claim system
functional.source_quote: It should also pre-fill the claim number, dates and amounts so nobody is retyping them.

functional.statement: Give team leads a view of draft quality across their team
functional.source_quote: Team leads should get a simple view of draft quality across their team.

functional.statement: Support injury-claim correspondence from day one
functional.source_quote: Injury claims are where the backlog is, so they have to be in from day one.

non_functional.statement: Drafting must be fast; adjusters will not wait
non_functional.source_quote: It needs to be fast. Adjusters won't wait around for a computer.

non_functional.statement: All-in cost under one dollar per letter
non_functional.source_quote: Keep it under a dollar per letter all-in.

constraints.statement: Live before renewal season - January 15 at the latest
constraints.source_quote: I need this live before renewal season. January 15 at the latest.

positions.stance: Auto-send simple letters; adjusters approve complex letters only
Injury claims included from day one
Under $1 per letter all-in (about $9,000/month at 9,000 letters)

success_metrics.name: Letter backlog
success_metrics.target: Cleared within three months of go-live

risks: Low adoption if adjusters do not trust the drafts
open_questions: Who owns the letter templates - Customer Experience or Legal?
